|strategy=Who wouldn't like to try and retrieve 1 Force from the Lost Pile every turn?

Figrin works best when you play a deck of high destiny numbers. But, even if you do have some low numbers, Figrin is always handy!

With the Light Side drawing 3 cards, and the Dark Side drawing only 2, you should be able to outnumber your opponent most of the time!

Be sure to protect him though, he only has power 1, and is normally a prime target for the Dark Side.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020530182733/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/figrindan.html</ref>
